name: Takatoo Tasuku
source:
Member of the Winter Troupe.

"He was enrolled in GOD-za for a top spot, but he left them due to certain reasons and joined the MANKAI Company in turn. He's a stoic person who takes his acting seriously. Although he is manly, he can be clumsy and isn't good at speaking. He was childhood friends with Tsumugi and they were in the same theatre circle until the end of their university days."

[From the [url=https://yaycupcake.com/a3/index.php?title=Tasuku_Takato]A3! Wiki[/url]]
